explanation_short: Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate exhibit the highest mean values, while Ethanol also shows the highest standard deviation among the measured features.
explanation_full: The descriptive statistics reveal that Ethanol (mean: 0.4736) and Acetate (mean: 0.4465) have the highest mean concentrations, followed closely by Butyrate (mean: 0.4287). Propionate (mean: 0.3675) and VSS (mean: 0.3581) show lower average levels. Regarding variability, Ethanol exhibits the largest standard deviation (0.2528), followed by Butyrate (0.2474), and then Acetate (0.226). These findings provide a clear quantitative comparison of the central tendency and spread of the key metabolic features.
